about: The new artists we're most excited about!

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 25 Dec. Disfreq takes over the Future Flex Mini Mix for five minutes of bangers. Plus, Sian puts you onto another rising name in Next Wave. Produced by Listen for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Future Flex from Disfreq

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 24 Dec. Mackenzy Mackay performs live for Future Artists, including the first-ever live performance of new single Hardway. Plus, Sian puts you onto another rising name in Next Wave. Produced by Listen for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Live music from Mackenzy Mackay

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 18 Dec. Jedsoul drops in to chat about his new EP, while Waylon Wyatt joins us ahead of his UK tour. Plus, another emerging artist gets the Next Wave spotlight. Produced by Listen for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Jedsoul and Waylon Wyatt

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 17 Dec. Aaron Rowe joins us for a live session, performing some of his biggest tracks. Plus, a catch-up with Mercury in Next Wave. Produced by Listen for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Live music from Aaron Rowe

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 11 Dec. Chloe Slater joins for a game of The Ultimate Song, and we spotlight another exciting emerging artist in Next Wave. Produced by Listen for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: The Ultimate Chloe Slater Song!

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 10 Dec. Basht play live music from their debut album Poor Advice, and we catch up with MISSU in Next Wave. Produced by Listen for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Live music from Basht

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 4 Dec. Cristale drops a Future Flex Freestyle ahead of her new mixtape Clear Intentions, and Sian spotlights another exciting emerging artist in Next Wave. Produced by Listen for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Future Flex with Cristale

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 3 Dec. Sian crowns Say Now as Radio 1's Future Artist of the Month for November and catches up with alt-pop artist Bluegirl in Next Wave. Produced by Listen for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Future Artist of the Month: Say Now
